sections.h2: What we find inside older homes
body: Inside an older High Springs home you might find wallpaper under three coats of paint, original window and door casings with chipped edges, and ceilings with old cracks that open every summer. Interior painting in High Springs, FL in these homes is careful work. We strip what needs stripping, fill what needs filling, and keep the details that give the rooms their character.

Wallpaper is a common surprise. Painting over it rarely works, because seams lift and bubbles show. Our article on removing wallpaper without damaging drywall explains how we take it off without tearing the wall surface, and our wallpaper removal service lists it as its own line item.

Wood trim is often where an older interior looks best, and where a poor paint job is most obvious. We degloss, fill dents, and caulk only joints that have actually separated. Then we apply a waterborne urethane enamel that levels out smoothly and stays hard. Built-in shelves and bookcases get the same treatment. If you'd rather keep wood stained, ask about our wood staining and finishing service.

sections.h2: Newer homes in Bridlewood and Bailey Estates
body: Newer interiors are more straightforward but take more wear. We patch nail pops, match the wall texture, and switch high-traffic areas to a washable satin. Matte works best on big, bright walls where sheen would show flaws. Ceilings are often added to the same job, and a standard repaint can be combined with popcorn removal.

body: Older rooms with deep porches and smaller windows get less light than newer open plans, so a color that works in one can look muddy in the other. Our High Springs color consultation uses full-size samples on your walls. For more on the general method, see our interior painting page, or return to High Springs services.

faqs.a: We don't recommend it, because seams and bubbles show through. We remove the wallpaper, repair the wall surface, prime, and then paint.

faqs.q: What finish is best for wood trim?
faqs.a: A waterborne urethane enamel. It levels out smoothly, cures hard, and stands up to cleaning better than wall paint.

faqs.q: Do I need to move my furniture?
faqs.a: No. Crews move and cover furniture, work one room at a time, and clean up each day, so you can keep using the rest of the house.

faqs.q: How long does one room take?
faqs.a: Usually one day. Rooms with wallpaper removal or significant plaster or drywall repair take longer, and the estimate will show that.
